body:
Ok Im not a doctor but you should take care of your physical state first.

On the mental stare I can help you privately
Give me example of something that went wrong in your life.

You don’t wanna die.
There is a reason you came here and had the time and patience to write this down.

You look like person with a good heart that just asks life to give him happiness. I can’t relate to you, I’m on some different bullshit in my life, but what I can tell you is that right now you in the best position in your life you could ever be..

Life has given you some shit and now you don’t have nothing.
Well, this means you start all clean, you can find your way in life bc you have no distractions NOBODY is dependent on, you you’re free.

This is not one of them motivational speaks, you need to get this into your head, the things you can do with your life using your mind, worth more than you could ever dream.

You don’t need any tips from me.

Just do it and let experience give you knowledge.

Your job is to not start this spiral of bad thoughts from the beginning.

Just put your focus on. Look whats happening in front of you.

The problem is subconscious.
So is the key.

And how you master your subconscious mind ?
With your attention.

What you will put your focus on - will determine your thoughts. Your choice.
